purpose: Freeze the E226 all_blocks_v2 representation and map the joint reachable region over a train-side-only threshold grid. A = target known acceptance on the fold's inner OOF scores, tau = (1-A) quantile. Report LOSO rejection vs Test S1 rejection vs Test S2 acceptance for A in [0.70..0.99]; add two block-weighting schemes driven by single-block LOSO AUC (leave-one-fold-out, no Test, no held identity).

predecessor.note: E226 tau rule = 10% quantile of inner OOF known scores, i.e. A = 0.90. This experiment reproduces that point bitwise as the A=0.90 row.

representation.name: all_blocks_v2
representation.frozen: Feature extraction is NOT re-designed. Arrays are read from the frozen E226/E225/E65 caches produced by research/E226_stable_feature_families_v2/run_e226.py.

feature_cache.reuse_note: Read-only reuse. E227 writes only inside research/E227_joint_frontier/.

protocol.score_rule: score = -min euclidean distance to same-task k12 prototypes (higher = known); reject if score < tau; identity = nearest prototype identity
protocol.open_set_direction: high score = known; unknown is the positive class for rejection F1 and AUC(-score)

threshold_grid.rule: tau(A) = (1-A) quantile of the inner 5-block OOF known scores of the fold's fit rows; higher A = stricter gate. A uses Train-side rows only, never Test.
threshold_grid.note: A = target known acceptance on Train. The realised known acceptance is A up to inner-OOF vs outer-fit mismatch.

block_weighting.none: w_b = 1 for all 10 blocks (E226 all_blocks_v2, reproduction target).
block_weighting.auc_lofo: w_b proportional to the leave-one-fold-out mean of the single-block LOSO AUC (folds != held) over the 20 block-only results already cached by E226; normalised to mean 1.
block_weighting.auc2_lofo: same but weights proportional to AUC^2, normalised to mean 1.
block_weighting.application: Features are task-wise standardised, multiplied by sqrt(w_b) inside block b, then PCA96 and k12 prototypes. Block weight vectors are fold-specific and logged for every fold.
block_weighting.leakage_rule: Fold held's block weight never uses held's evaluation-window rows: only the other 19 folds' block-only AUC values are averaged. No Test information.

decision_rule.comparators: > for LOSO rejection, >= for Test S1 rejection, > for Test S2 acceptance (identical to E226 freeze_all).
decision_rule.closest_point_gap: sum of max(0, 0.90-LOSO) + max(0, 0.70-S1) + max(0, 0.70-S2); lower is closer.
decision_rule.no_test_tuning: Every scheme, weight formula and A value is fixed in this file before the run. Test is read once, after all Train-side artefacts are frozen.

official_note: Official Test AUC/F1 = N/A: Test has no identity labels.
